As AI automates entry-level corporate roles, the next generation is choosing fields where human presence is physically mandatory, such as electrical and HVAC work.

The Bright Side:
This shift forces a long-overdue revaluation of vocational training and physical infrastructure in the national economy.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
There is no plane error here; the actors are correctly identifying the HOW (AI automation) and the WHERE (the physical labor market).

By embracing physical trades, Gen Z is moving from a high-strain, competitive digital environment to a low-strain, high-utility physical one. This is an empowering shift toward tangible, non-automatable value.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening.
When you map the alignment between economic reality and workforce behavior, it plots a trajectory toward Grace. The shift reduces systemic friction by matching labor to actual needs.

The Unavoidable Truth: AI is fundamentally altering the value of entry-level white-collar labor.
The Unavoidable Lie: Traditional four-year degrees remain the most reliable path to financial security.
